{{Top}}
A '''suicide pill''',<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> also known as a '''poison pill''',<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> was a tablet that allowed an individual to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]]. [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[area coordinator]]s carried suicide pills, nicknamed "lullabies," in case of capture.<ref name="RASB" /> [[Bria Tharen]] used such a pill to end her life and avoid capture during the [[Battle of Toprawa]].<ref name="ERC" />
